english: Now as they spoke to the people, the priests, the captain of the temple, and the Sadducees came upon them,
chiru: Peter le John na mi hai dieng chawngruriei u lai khan thiempu hai, riethiengmun arung ralamkai le Sadducee hai na amani dieng va uh.

english: being greatly disturbed that they taught the people and preached in Jesus the resurrection from the dead.
chiru: Jesu dieng athi ah put ah thoiretna awm, tia miring hai kha iruruchuk a irurophong u kha na amani mulung kha rumahang pe.

english: And they laid hands on them, and put them in custody until the next day, for it was already evening.
chiru: Khajarkhan amani kha rushur uh. Nitak runit jarkhan, jing tiengshe khan lungroko shung ah amani kha rukhum uh.

english: However, many of those who heard the word believed; and the number of the men came to be about five thousand.
chiru: Inia chawng rangai hai tampui na takarushawn uh, khan amani jat kha bawp rahnga dawr runih.

english: And it came to pass, on the next day, that their rulers, elders, and scribes,
chiru: Jing tieng hin rampo hai, lamkai hai, khan danoja hai kha na Jerusalem ah ruruchun joi.

english: as well as Annas the high priest, Caiaphas, John, and Alexander, and as many as were of the family of the high priest, were gathered together at Jerusalem.
chiru: Thiempu rashang Annas le Caiaphas, John, Alexander, khan thiempu rashang inshung hai tampui ruawm uh.

english: And when they had set them in the midst, they asked, By what power or by what name have you done this?
chiru: Peter le John kha alai ah miding a rurawdawn uh, Ih ranak ninawkle tu riming a mahi nangithaw u maw nih?

english: Then Peter, filled with the Holy Spirit, said to them, Rulers of the people and elders of Israel:
chiru: Ratha Riethieng shiplam a Peter na amani dieng ruriei, Miring chung a chamniei hai le Israel lamkai hai,

english: If we this day are judged for a good deed done to a helpless man, by what means he has been made well,
chiru: Von hin anapa dieng chon atha thaw jar a le itia hi miringpa damna dan kha kieini dieng ennanginerete u nitjoiatu,

english: let it be known to you all, and to all the people of Israel, that by the name of Jesus Christ of Nazareth, whom you crucified, whom God raised from the dead, by Him this man stands here before you whole.
chiru: nang kholok le Israel miring kholok na ijet nih rosho, mahi Nazareth Jesu Christa riming a nang kar ua damveng a ading nih joi. Mahi Jesu hi nangni na cross ah nangiruthat u, khan Pathien na athi ah put ah irumothoi kha inih.

english: This is the 'stone which was rejected by you builders, which has become the chief cornerstone.'
chiru: Mahi Inthaw hai nangni na nirudawnda u runiei kik ah lung ruchang kha inih.

english: Nor is there salvation in any other, for there is no other name under heaven given among men by which we must be saved.
chiru: Tute jar a shandamna hi awm mak, ajarla kieini niringna u rang ravan noi a awm miring hai kar a ipek riming shik awm mak.

english: Now when they saw the boldness of Peter and John, and perceived that they were uneducated and untrained men, they marveled. And they realized that they had been with Jesus.
chiru: Khan amani na Peter le John mulung ngar kha rumuk u phakhan, amani kha behangthiei boi, miriem inih, iti kha rujet ua shindawngna runiei uh. Khan amani kha Jesu le rawtawp miring hai keng, iti kha rujet uh.

english: And seeing the man who had been healed standing with them, they could say nothing against it.
chiru: Amani na irumadam u miringpa kha akar ua ading kha rumuk u jarkhan, amani na ama chung a chawngruriei ngam u mak.

english: But when they had commanded them to go aside out of the council, they conferred among themselves,
chiru: Khajarkhan Sanhedrin kha mathan a shena rang, chawng rupek u shole, chonmun kha amani na rureshe uh.

english: saying, What shall we do to these men? For, indeed, that a notable miracle has been done through them is evident to all who dwell in Jerusalem, and we cannot deny it.
chiru: Khan amani na ruti uh, Amani dieng imaw nithaw u rang? Ajarla Jerusalem ah awm mi kholok dieng jetna ithawna hi madang joi. Mahi kieini na shok mak ti rang a hi anithiei boi inih.

english: But so that it spreads no further among the people, let us severely threaten them, that from now on they speak to no man in this name.
chiru: Inia miring hai dieng dawnshe a majarna boi rang le hi riming hin tute dieng rieina boi rang, michitrip u rang rawi.

english: So they called them and commanded them not to speak at all nor teach in the name of Jesus.
chiru: Khajarkhan amani kha rukoi ua Jesu riming a chawngriei ninawkle ruchukna boipet rang, chawng rupek u joi.

english: But Peter and John answered and said to them, Whether it is right in the sight of God to listen to you more than to God, you judge.
chiru: Inia Peter le John na rumashang uh, Pathiennek a nang chawng u rangai rang a hi Pathien mik`en a dikna maw chang nih, chawngshat u roh.

english: For we cannot but speak the things which we have seen and heard.
chiru: Ajarla kimuk u le kijet u chungchanga chawngriei hi bang ngam u naw ning.

english: So when they had further threatened them, they let them go, finding no way of punishing them, because of the people, since they all glorified God for what had been done.
chiru: Takthar a amani kha rumichitsho u le, rumeshe u joi. Ajarla ashok chon jarkhan mi kholok na Pathien kha mapak a ruawm le khan amani jarkhan, amani chepna rang, lam rumuk u mak.

english: For the man was over forty years old on whom this miracle of healing had been performed.
chiru: Ajarla damna chonrekhek ithawna miringpa kha kum shawm mili khe miring runih joi.

english: And being let go, they went to their own companions and reported all that the chief priests and elders had said to them.
chiru: Amani kha rumoshoksho u le, thiempu ulien le shierulien hai na amani dieng iruriei hai kha Peter le John na amani lawm hai dieng thang vak koi uh.

english: So when they heard that, they raised their voice to God with one accord and said: Lord, You are God, who made heaven and earth and the sea, and all that is in them,
chiru: Khan amani na rujet u `le, mulung `khat a he rashangtak a Pathien dieng ruti uh, Aw Pumpa, nang ravan le rieliei, thampui le ushung ah awm kholok akonpa kha nangnih.

english: who by the mouth of Your servant David have said: Why did the nations rage, And the people plot vain things?
chiru: Nang shokpa David ner a nangruriei: Ijar a phung hai kha rurang u maw nih, khan miring hai na nemna boi a chonirashak u maw nih?

english: The kings of the earth took their stand, And the rulers were gathered together Against the Lord and against His Christ.
chiru: Rieliei reng hai na rumiding u joi, khan rampo hai na PUMI chung a le ama Christa chung a re`erpuina rang, ruruchun u joi.

english: For truly against Your holy Servant Jesus, whom You anointed, both Herod and Pontius Pilate, with the Gentiles and the people of Israel, were gathered together
chiru: Ajarla diktak a thao nangirunawt nang shok riethieng Jesu chung a Herod le Pontius Pilate na Phungshik hai, khan Israel miring hai le lawp `khat a ruruchun u joi.

english: to do whatever Your hand and Your purpose determined before to be done.
chiru: Makha nang ranak le nang mulungmining nirumuchuksha kha ashok inih.

english: Now, Lord, look on their threats, and grant to Your servants that with all boldness they may speak Your word,
chiru: Tun, Aw Pumi, amani mimichit hi enro, khan mulungartak a nang chawng kha rieina rang, nang shok hai dieng hin ranak peh roh.

english: by stretching out Your hand to heal, and that signs and wonders may be done through the name of Your holy Servant Jesus.
chiru: Nang mimadamna nang ranak kha jong peh tana, jetna le rekhekchon hai kha nang shok riethieng Jesu riming a thaw u rosho.

english: And when they had prayed, the place where they were assembled together was shaken; and they were all filled with the Holy Spirit, and they spoke the word of God with boldness.
chiru: Amani na nikna kha runieisho u le, lawp `khat a ruchunna u mun kha hawng rawnawk, khan amani kholok dieng Ratha Riethieng na jong ship ua Pathien chawng kha ngartak a ariei ruput u joi.

english: Now the multitude of those who believed were of one heart and one soul; neither did anyone say that any of the things he possessed was his own, but they had all things in common.
chiru: Khan takashawn mipui kha mulung `khat le ringphuk `khat a ruawm uh. Tute na`awm inleloi kha bing niei rumachang u mak, inia irawkhawm u rikip kha mun `khat a rurotokna uh.

english: And with great power the apostles gave witness to the resurrection of the Lord Jesus. And great grace was upon them all.
chiru: Ranaknieitak a tirtawn hai kha na Pumi Jesu thoiretna khan kungruchang uh, khan amani kholok chung a numpokmirit kha lawmlawm a jong pe uh.

english: Nor was there anyone among them who lacked; for all who were possessors of lands or houses sold them, and brought the proceeds of the things that were sold,
chiru: Amani kar a ravat `khatshe ruawm pe u mak, ajarla inleloi aniei hai kha na rujor ua khahai man kha vak chawi uh.

english: and laid them at the apostles' feet; and they distributed to each as anyone had need.
chiru: Amani na tirtawn hai keshun khan vak tet ua rangai hai dieng khan rushem pe uh.

english: And Joses, who was also named Barnabas by the apostles (which is translated Son of Encouragement), a Levite of the country of Cyprus,
chiru: Cyprus tuikawram a ashok, Levi phung Joses iti miring `khat ruawm. Tirtawn hai na ama dieng Barnabas iti riming kha rupek uh (Makha mawshawkna apeh shapa tina inih).

english: having land, sold it, and brought the money and laid it at the apostles' feet.
chiru: Ama na iniei loipuk kha rujor a shier kha tirtawn hai keshun a vak tet.
